notes:
Chat now puts saved conversations in a searchable column beside the active thread. Type to filter titles and previews, or use Search saved messages to jump directly to a match. You can start a chat, switch threads with an unfinished draft, and copy a reply. At narrower window sizes the conversation list opens as a drawer.

The Cale Media layout adds a serif conversation title, teal user bubbles, a Cale-branded reply and a message box anchored to the bottom. Web search, attachments, saved files, voice, camera and project tools remain available.

Desktop checks covered draft restoration, full-text search, a locally answered message, copying replies and reload at desktop and compact sizes. Separate regression checks covered private previews and interrupted replies.
